name: McGraw Hill, Inc.
summary: McGraw Hill, Inc., doing business as McGraw Hill, provides education solutions for K-12, higher education, and professional learning in the United States and internationally. It operates through K-12, Higher Education, Global Professional, and International segments. The K-12 segment provides core, supplemental, and intervention curricula to support the needs of the K-12 schools. This segment also sells blended digital and print learning solutions directly to school districts across the United States.
